title: Playing for amusement while holding a regular job
summary: Paul says he played for amusement and felt the music, though the other musicians did not know it, because he held a regular job in those years.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: No, you said playing for amusement.
Oh, no, I wouldn't give that for an excuse, just for amusement. But I felt it, but the fellas didn't know it. Because I had a regular job during those times and during those years.
